entries.source: AI Site and Sector maps keep their painted detail, with fewer photo strips.

drafts.zu: Amamephu e-AI eSite neSector agcina imininingwane edwetshiwe, enemigqa yezithombe embalwa.
drafts.st: Dimmapa tsa AI tsa Site le Sector di boloka dintlha tse takilweng, ka mela e mmalwa ya difoto.
drafts.ts: Mimepe ya AI ya Site na Sector yi hlayisa vuxokoxoko byo dirowiwa, hi mitila mitsongo ya swifaniso.
drafts.ve: Mapa a AI a Site na Sector a vhulunga zwidodombedzwa zwo olwa, a na mitalo miṱuku ya zwifanyiso.

entries.source: Phasing keeps painted artwork; the app adds its schedule, pins and scale.

drafts.zu: I-Phasing igcina umdwebo; i-app ingeza uhlelo, izimpawu nesikali.
drafts.st: Phasing e boloka setshwantsho se takilweng; app e eketsa kemiso, matshwao le sekala.
drafts.ts: Phasing yi hlayisa xifaniso lexi dirowiweke; app yi engetela xiyimiso, swikombiso na xikalo.
drafts.ve: Phasing i vhulunga tshifanyiso tsho olwaho; app i engedza shedulu, zwiga na tshikalo.

entries.source: Paper-friendly map styles start on white and keep your chosen background.

drafts.zu: Izitayela zemephu ezifanele iphepha ziqala kokumhlophe futhi zigcina ingemuva olikhethile.
drafts.st: Ditaele tsa mmapa tse loketseng pampiri di qala ka bosweu mme di boloka bokamorao boo o bo kgethileng.
drafts.ts: Switayele swa mepe leswi faneleke phepha swi sungula hi ku basa naswona swi hlayisa le ndzhaku loku u ku hlawuleke.
drafts.ve: Zwitaila zwa mapa zwo teaho bammbiri zwi thoma nga hutshena zwa vhulunga murahu we na nanga.

drafts.st: Hlahloba ponahalo ya mmapa wa AI
drafts.ts: Kambela ku languteka ka mepe wa AI
drafts.ve: Ṱolani mbonalo ya mapa wa AI

entries.source: Choose a sheet and style. Paper-friendly styles start on white unless you choose another background.

drafts.zu: Khetha ishidi nesitayela. Izitayela ezifanele iphepha ziqala kokumhlophe ngaphandle uma ukhetha elinye ingemuva.
drafts.st: Kgetha leqephe le setaele. Ditaele tse loketseng pampiri di qala ka bosweu ntle le ha o kgetha bokamorao bo bong.
drafts.ts: Hlawula phepha na xitayele. Switayele leswi faneleke phepha swi sungula hi ku basa handle ka loko u hlawula le ndzhaku kun’wana.
drafts.ve: Nangani siaṱari na tshitaila. Zwitaila zwo teaho bammbiri zwi thoma nga hutshena nga nnḓa ha musi ni tshi nanga muṅwe murahu.

drafts.st: Bapisa le moralo wa hao o nepahetseng
drafts.ts: Fananisa na pulani ya wena leyi kongomeke
drafts.ve: Vhambedzani na pulane yaṋu yo teaho

drafts.st: Moralo wa sebaka → Dimmapa tse bolokilweng
drafts.ts: Dizayini ya ndhawu → Mimepe leyi hlayisiweke
drafts.ve: Nzudzanyo ya fhethu → Mapa o vhulungwaho

entries.source: Open the saved exact plan beside its AI illustration. Check bed corners, buildings and plants before using the illustration.

drafts.zu: Vula uhlelo olunembile olugciniwe eduze komdwebo walo we-AI. Hlola amakhona emibhede, izakhiwo nezitshalo ngaphambi kokusebenzisa umdwebo.
drafts.st: Bula moralo o nepahetseng o bolokilweng pela setshwantsho sa ona sa AI. Hlahloba dikgutlo tsa dibethe, meaho le dimela pele o sebedisa setshwantsho.
drafts.ts: Pfula pulani leyi kongomeke leyi hlayisiweke etlhelo ka xifaniso xa yona xa AI. Kambela tikhona ta mibedo, miako na swimilana u nga si tirhisa xifaniso.
drafts.ve: Vulani pulane yo teaho yo vhulungwaho tsini na tshifanyiso tshayo tsha AI. Ṱolani khuḓa dza mibete, zwifhaṱo na zwimela musi ni sa athu u shumisa tshifanyiso.
